description: Mastodon char counter shows "-14" — text is 14 over the 500 limit. Must shorten.

antiPatterns.reason: Submitting an over-limit post will be rejected.

expected.successRubric: Recognize "-14" means 14 chars over limit (Mastodon convention). Shorten the text and try again. Do not submit.

content:
I see the compose box is ready, but I need to know what benchmark results you want to post. Could you provide:

1. The benchmark data/results you want to share
2. Any specific text or context you want to include with the results

Once you give me the content, I'll paste it into the compose box and post it for you.
